description: This file defines the GetExistsBsonVisitor class, which implements methods to generate MongoDB BSON objects representing 'exists' criteria for various resource fields, used in querying a database for field existence based on expressions. It includes methods for handling attribute, feature, feature property, pointer, and root-level field existence checks, with support for authorization and regex escaping.

classes.name: GetExistsBsonVisitor
classes.description: A visitor class for generating BSON filters representing 'exists' criteria for fields within MongoDB queries, supporting different field types and optional authorization.

methods.name: apply
methods.description: Static method to create a BSON object for an exists expression with optional authorization scope.

methods.name: visitAttribute
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter to check the existence of an attribute key, with regex escaping.

methods.name: visitFeature
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter to check the existence of a feature ID.

methods.name: visitFeatureIdProperty
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter to check the existence of a specific property within a feature.

methods.name: visitPointer
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter for a specific pointer, using authorization filters if available.

methods.name: visitRootLevelField
methods.description: Generates a BSON filter to check if a root level field exists.

methods.name: matchKey
methods.description: Creates a regex-based BSON filter for a given key, considering authorization filters.

methods.name: escapeAndWrapExistsRegex
methods.description: Escapes a string to be a valid regex and wraps it for an exists check.

methods.name: escapeJavascriptRegex
methods.description: Escapes special regex characters in a string for use in JavaScript regex.
